title: Deleting the last task shows an error instead of the empty state
body:
## Summary

When the final task is deleted, the application shows an error screen
instead of displaying the empty task list state.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Launch the application.
2. Delete tasks one by one.
3. Delete the final remaining task.
4. Observe the screen.

## Expected behavior

The task list should become empty and display a message such as
"No tasks yet".

## Actual behavior

The application displays:

> Failed to load tasks

The error also reports that no tasks were found in local storage.

## Additional context

- Deleting tasks works correctly until the final task.
- The problem only occurs when zero tasks remain.
- Restarting the application restores the seeded tasks.
- The issue is unrelated to refresh.
